title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Proficiency in C++, Java, or Python; experience with data structures and algorithms.
description: As a Software Engineering Intern, you will work on core products and infrastructure critical to Google's operations and growth.

title: Chevening Foreign & Commonwealth Office Scholarship
eligibility: Undergraduate degree that enables entry into a postgraduate programme at a UK university; at least 2 years work experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree with upper second-class honours or equivalent.
description: Chevening enables outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue one-year master's degrees in the UK.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open to candidates worldwide with a reliable internet connection.
qualification: 1+ years of experience with Vue.js or React, HTML/CSS, and Git.
description: Join GitLab's fully remote engineering team to build scalable UI components and improve developer workflows.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent graduates or professionals with 0-2 years of relevant experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, or related discipline.
description: Lead features from inception to launch, collaborating with design, engineering, and data science teams.

title: Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university.
qualification: Team of up to 4 students developing an innovative software application using Microsoft Azure.
description: Microsoft Imagine Cup is a global student technology competition empowering the next generation of innovators.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone globally, no prior programming experience required.
description: An entry-level course teaching students how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, and Web Tech.
